inputs.prompt: Still life of a traditional Ethiopian coffee set. A jebena: a matte black clay bottle with a round ball-shaped base and one tall slender vertical tube neck like a narrow bottle, a small woven straw stopper in the top of the neck, a curved clay loop handle joining neck and base. Beside it four small white porcelain bowl-shaped cups, smooth round sides, thin green rim, on a low dark wooden tray. Fresh green grass on an earthen floor, soft firelight from the side. Hand-painted gouache illustration, visible brush texture, soft film grain, warm amber and terracotta palette with deep indigo shadows, gentle firelight, quiet and intimate, subject centred in frame, full-bleed painting reaching every edge
